offering_description.value: Franchises resale retail stores that buy and sell used clothing, children's items, sporting goods and musical instruments, selling franchises to independent owners. Earns royalties and franchise fees from franchisees, and runs a small equipment leasing business.

primary_products.value: resale store franchises; leased business equipment

primary_services.value: franchising and franchisee support; equipment leasing

customer_segment.value: B2B: independent franchisee owners, small businesses leasing equipment

end_markets.value: used apparel retail; children's resale; sporting goods resale; musical instrument resale

revenue_model.value: licensing or royalties: royalties as a percentage of franchisee store sales; service fees: initial franchise fees and franchisee support fees; rental or leasing: lease income from equipment leases; product sales: merchandise and supplies sold to franchisees
revenue_model.category: licensing or royalties; service fees; rental or leasing; product sales

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: owns resale retail brands and licenses them to franchisees who run the stores; financial intermediary: leases equipment to small businesses

geography_served.value: North America: franchised stores across the US and Canada

specialization.value: related lines: resale franchise brands in apparel, kids, sports and music, plus small leasing line

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: franchise sales to prospective franchisees; own locations: franchisee-operated resale stores sell to consumers and buy used goods

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: franchise disclosure rules (FTC Franchise Rule, state franchise laws), lending and leasing rules

notes: Details of the small leasing segment and current brand lineup are from memory and may be dated.
